exercises.title: Part 1 · 1
exercises.prompt: Do you have a favourite café? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 2
exercises.prompt: Do you often go to cafés by yourself? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 3
exercises.prompt: What do you think helps to make a café very popular? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 4
exercises.prompt: Why do some people prefer cafés that are part of large chains, rather than small, local cafés?

exercises.title: Part 2 · 1
exercises.prompt: Describe a place you visited that has beautiful views. You should say: where this place is when and why you visited it what views you can see from this place and explain why you think these views are so beautiful.

exercises.title: Part 3 · 1
exercises.prompt: Do you agree that most beauty products are a waste of money?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 2
exercises.prompt: How does the beauty industry advertise its products so successfully?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 3
exercises.prompt: What do you think of the view that beauty products should not be advertised to children?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 4
exercises.prompt: Why do many people equate youth with beauty?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 5
exercises.prompt: Do you think that being beautiful could affect a person’s success in life?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 6
exercises.prompt: Why might society’s ideas about beauty change over time?
